name: C.G. Mistry
role: Deputy Regional Director, ASQ Pacific Region; ASQ Fellow
bio:
C.G. Mistry is a quality and business professional with more than 40 years of experience in quality, including plant and quality department set-up, training in quality methods, Kaizen, and Lean manufacturing and management. He has worked across the commercial, aerospace, defense, and nuclear industries.

C.G. holds an MBA from the University of La Verne and an MSQA from Cal State Dominguez Hills, and teaches at Cal State Dominguez Hills and Cal Poly Pomona. He trains refresher courses for ASQ certifications in CMQ/OE, CQE, CQA, CSQP, and Six Sigma Green and Black Belt, and is himself ASQ certified as a CMQ/OE, CQE, CQA, and CSSBB.

An ASQ member since 1994, he has twice chaired the San Gabriel Valley Section 702, served six years as an ASQ Regional Director, and is now Deputy Regional Director for the Pacific Region. He is an ASQ Fellow and received the Simon Collier Award in 2021.
